diagnosis: The WorkspaceUserResource formats user entities for team directory listings but includes secret SSO tokens, Stripe customer IDs, and multi-factor recovery codes without conditional scoping. Any authenticated team member querying the team members endpoint can extract colleagues' recovery secrets and external billing IDs.

GET /api/workspaces/current/users/92 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.collaborate-saas.com
Authorization: Bearer 34|userleveltoken123456789
Accept: application/json
